name: install-docs
body: Install documentation explains, in plain language for non-developers, how to get repo access (really-knows-ai/kalide), create a GitHub token with the needed scope, set it (`HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN` on macOS; `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN` for the Scoop install on Windows), add the tap/bucket (`really-knows-ai/kalide` / `kalide`), install, and upgrade. Linux has no package-manager channel: the docs direct Linux users to download the matching `kalide-linux-<arch>` asset from the GitHub Release, make it executable (`chmod +x`), and run it directly. AC: following the docs on a clean machine of each supported OS gets `kalide` installed or runnable.
